full_name: Kimerer LaMothe | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2000–2001 Humanities Frieda L. Miller Fellow, Bunting Program Harvard University
bio: Religious studies scholar and dancer Kimerer LaMothe draws upon disciplines of philosophy, theology, dance, ritual and performance studies, and the comparative study of religion in pursuing questions regarding the relationship between religion and dance.
